more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Butylated hydroxyanisole is used as an antioxidant in food. Its technological role is to slow oxidation in food.
more_info.side_effects:
Refined food-use estimates were generally below EFSA's limit.
High-dose animal studies reported effects on offspring growth and survival; rodent forestomach findings have uncertain human relevance.
